source.title: Belfast News-Letter, 17 January 1927, p. 8 ("Belfast municipal elections: ward results"); Belfast News-Letter, 6 January 1927, p. 8 ("The unopposed returns")
source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: votes from the News-Letter's ward results (INA OCR); * = retiring member as printed; where the OCR of a vote is garbled the figure used is the one that agrees with both the printed valid votes and the printed majority; unopposed returns from the News-Letter of 7 January 1927

note: Annual election of one councillor in each of the 15 wards of Belfast Corporation (the member retiring in rotation), nominations 5 January, poll Saturday 15 January 1927. Seven retiring members were returned unopposed after Zimri Stewart withdrew in St Anne's, and eight wards were contested (Belfast News-Letter, 6, 7 and 17 January 1927). Clokey replaced the retiring member, Miss M'Comb, who did not stand again; the OCR prints his initials as W. P. (W. F. in the nomination report).
